prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — a few quick questions first:
- Is this for a home irrigation/sprinkler system, a commercial property, or a fire-protection system?
- Do you want businesses right in Liberty, MO (zip 64068) or in the broader Kansas City area?

I can’t run a live web search from here, but meanwhile here’s a practical plan and what to look for so you can quickly find a qualified tester/repairer near Liberty.

Where to look
- City of Liberty / Liberty Public Works or your water utility: they often maintain a list of approved or certified backflow testers who are familiar with local reporting requirements.
- Search engines, Google Maps, Yelp, Nextdoor, or HomeAdvisor for “backflow tester Liberty MO” or “backflow testing near 64068.”
- Large plumbing chains that commonly do backflow work: Roto-Rooter, Mr. Rooter, and local plumbing or irrigation companies. Fire-protection contractors also test/repair fire line backflow devices.

What to ask/verify when you call
- Are you a certified backflow tester? (Ask for tester certification number or certificate.)
- Do you file the required test report with the city/water utility? (Some utilities require electronic filing.)
- Do you carry liability insurance and a current business license?
- Do you repair backflow assemblies? If so, what parts/brand do you use and do you provide a warranty?
- Estimated cost for testing and for common repairs (so you can compare quotes).
- Availability — many testers can do a quick test (15–30 minutes), repairs may require parts and more time.

Typical costs (ballpark)
- Testing only: often about $75–$200 depending on device type and region.
- Repairs/rebuild: can range from $100 for small parts to $300–$800+ if a full rebuild or replacement is needed.
(These are estimates — get written quotes.)

If you want, I can:
- Draft a short phone script/email you can send to local companies.
- Help identify likely providers if you give your zip code or allow me to suggest search terms and review results you paste here.

Which would you like to do next?
